method.corpus: GTM-family postings (h1_ingest taxonomy) at companies in db/gtm_pipeline.db, plus YC WaaS roles
method.text: full posting text re-fetched live from Ashby / Greenhouse / Lever / YC WaaS where still open; else raw 6,000-char sweep payload; HN posts = full founder comment
method.scope_basis: duties are matched on the responsibilities section only (headings detected); postings with no responsibilities heading use body lines minus company intro / benefits / process sections
method.core: archetype in demand_gen, growth, gtm_engineer, gtm_generalist_lead, revops, sdr_bdr, or a founding / first-hire title
method.market_comparison: GTM postings at boards with >= 80 open jobs (scaled companies), random 12,000, seed 7; lift and two-proportion z on the same basis (flattened full text, 6,000-char cap)
method.company_level: a company counts once per duty if any of its usable GTM postings asks for it
method.nmf: TF-IDF (1-2 grams, min_df 8, max_df 0.25) over unique core responsibility lines; NMF k=30, seed 7
method.fx: fixed rates to USD: EUR 1.08, GBP 1.27, CHF 1.13, CAD 0.72; annual base midpoints 25K-600K only
method.limits: regex taxonomy => precision/recall not 100% (see taxonomy_coverage); postings != demand weight; closed postings use capped text; headcount known for a minority of companies
